enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking morning medication
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom and turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands and face. Apply soap and lather. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Open medicine cabinet, take out pill bottle, and open it. Take out one pill and put it in mouth. Pick up cup, fill with water, and drink to swallow pill. Close bottle, put it back, and close cabinet. Turn off light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog along the neighborhood streets
enriched_activities.desc: Attach leash to dog's collar. Open front door. Step outside. Close door. Walk along sidewalk. Hold leash. Stop at corner. Dog sniffs ground. Pull leash gently. Continue walking. Greet neighbor with 'Good morning'. Walk past houses. Turn around at end of street. Walk back. Open front door. Unleash dog. Close door.

Enter kitchen and turn on light. Open refrigerator, take out eggs, bread, butter, and close it. Toast bread. Crack eggs into bowl and whisk. Turn on stove, place pan, melt butter, pour eggs, stir, and flip. Turn off stove. Butter toast. Boil water, steep tea, and pour into cup.

Sit at dining table. Pick up fork. Cut egg. Lift fork to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Pick up toast. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put down cup. Continue eating. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet prayer and scripture reading at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open Bible. Read page. Turn page. Read more. Fold hands. Bow head. Close eyes. Pray silently. Open eyes. Read more. Close Bible. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbors on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Select relative contact. Type message. Send message. Wait for reply. Read reply. Type response. Send response. Select next contact. Type message. Send. Wait for reply. Read reply. Type response. Send. Put down phone.

Enter laundry room. Turn on light. Open washing machine. Load linens. Add detergent. Close door. Set cycle. Press start. Wait. Open washing machine. Transfer linens to dryer. Close dryer door. Set cycle. Press start. Wait. Remove linens. Fold linens. Put away linens. Turn off light. Walk out.

Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch program. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch program. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch program. Change channel. Watch program. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping with a cash budget
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk to produce aisle. Select vegetables. Place in basket. Walk to dairy aisle. Select milk. Place in basket. Walk to meat aisle. Select chicken. Place in basket. Walk to checkout. Wait in line. Pay cash. Receive change. Bag items. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and preparing a light lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Put bags on counter. Open refrigerator. Place milk inside. Place vegetables inside. Place chicken inside. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Place dry goods inside. Close cupboard. Take out bread. Take out lettuce. Take out tomato. Wash lettuce. Slice tomato. Assemble sandwich. Cut sandwich. Place on plate.

Sit at dining table. Pick up sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up glass. Sip water. Put down glass. Pick up sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Clear plate. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog and greeting neighbors
enriched_activities.desc: Attach leash to dog. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Walk along sidewalk. See neighbor. Wave. Say 'Hello'. Stop and talk. Continue walking. Greet another neighbor. Walk back home. Open door. Unleash dog. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing community outreach notes and answering messages on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter study. Turn on computer. Open email program. Read message. Type reply. Send reply. Open document. Review notes. Make notes. Close document. Open messaging app. Type message. Send message. Read reply. Type response. Send response. Close computer. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Visiting an elderly neighbor to drop off a meal
enriched_activities.desc: Prepare meal container. Cover container. Walk to neighbor's house. Knock on door. Wait. Neighbor opens door. Greet neighbor. Hand over meal. Chat about weather. Chat about health. Say goodbye. Walk home. Enter home. Close door.
Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch program. Adjust position. Recline. Close eyes. Rest. Open eyes. Watch program. Change channel. Watch program. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Stand up.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pot on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Cover pot. Simmer. Turn off stove. Serve food.

Sit at dining table. Serve food. Pick up fork. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Sip water. Put down cup. Pick up fork. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Clear table. Walk to kitchen.

Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch program. Change channel. Watch program. Adjust volume. Watch program. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch program. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Stand up.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Lie on bed. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch program. Adjust pillow. Watch program. Change channel. Watch program. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch program. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Texting relatives one-on-one and doing evening prayer
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Select relative. Type message, send. Wait for reply. Read reply. Type response, send. Select another relative. Type message, send. Wait for reply. Read reply. Type response, send. Put down phone. Fold hands, bow head, close eyes. Pray. Open eyes.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
